text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're all busy preparing for our promotion concert. Light Hello pulls more than her weight, making arrangements and handling all sorts of paperwork.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, our impromptu concert fails to draw a single spectator. A dejected Hello casts all the blame on herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon tries to lighten the mood, saying she'll definitely capture hearts at her next performance, but Hello still seems down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Over coffee, she confesses that she never had much concert experience herself, and therefore, doesn't know what makes a concert successful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, Agnes Tachyon sees one of our flyers and shows interest in the project. She announces that she'll be at our next concert—with a guest in tow.
